lyrics:
[Intro: pulsing synth riff, palm-muted guitar, heartbeat kick]

[Verse 1: low tense male voice, close]
He comes around at midnight with my face on
Same walk, same laugh, same jacket I had on
He knows where I kept the spare, he knows the code
He says, "Let me in. It's cold. You owe me. This is home."

[Pre-Chorus: drums build]
And I used to let him, every time
I'd hand him the keys and I'd call it mine

[Chorus: huge guitars, shouted melody]
But somebody changed the locks
He can knock, he can knock, he can knock
The man I was is on the porch tonight
And the door don't open from the outside
I didn't do it, I'm not that strong
Somebody changed the locks

[Verse 2: voice steadier, guitars chugging]
It was a carpenter. I'll tell you how it went.
He didn't ask what I could pay, he didn't ask for rent
He took the old door off its hinges with his hands
There were scars on both of them. He said, "I understand."

[Pre-Chorus: drums build]
He hung a new one, heavy, solid, true
Said, "I'll stand here. He goes through me to get to you."

[Chorus: huge guitars, shouted melody]
And somebody changed the locks
He can knock, he can knock, he can knock
The man I was is on the porch tonight
And the door don't open from the outside
I didn't do it, I'm not that strong
Somebody changed the locks

[Bridge: half-time, synths and stacked voices]
Old things gone, a new thing begun
I don't live there. I'm not that one.
And the knocking's getting further away

[Final Chorus: biggest, full band and voices]
'Cause Jesus changed the locks
He can knock, he can knock, he can knock
The man I was can stay out in the night
'Cause the one in my doorway is the Light
I didn't do it, I'm not that strong
Jesus changed the locks

[Outro: knocking fades, one synth note, a latch clicks]
